description: This file defines the interface for a Logger class within the mapf namespace, including configuration settings, logging macros, and external dependencies, used for logging in the prplMesh project.

classes.name: mapf::Logger
classes.description: Singleton class providing logging functionalities, including initialization, configuration, and logger name retrieval.

classes.name: mapf::Logger::Config
classes.description: Nested class within Logger for configuring logging parameters such as level, file path, and output options.

methods.name: Logger::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Logger class.

methods.name: Logger::LoggerInit
methods.description: Initializes the logger with default or specified settings.

methods.name: Logger::LoggerInit(const char*)
methods.description: Initializes the logger with a specific logger name.

methods.name: Logger::LoggerConfig
methods.description: Configures the logger with default or specified settings.

methods.name: Logger::LoggerConfig(const char*)
methods.description: Configures the logger with a specific logger name.

methods.name: Logger::LoggerConfig(Logger::Config&)
methods.description: Configures the logger using a provided Config object.

methods.name: Logger::logger_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger.
